## Checklist

- [ ] Run `bun run check`, or explain what prevented it.
- [ ] For behavior changes, add or update regression tests.
- [ ] For consumer features or fixes, add an `Unreleased` entry in `website/docs/release-notes.md`.
- [ ] For package or integration changes, run `bun run harness:offline`.
- [ ] For website changes, build the website and check the rendered pages.
